reading.action: Controlled experiment: push Ember Channel to MAXIMUM intensity against the steel Sentry pauldron — learn the heat ceiling. Melt it, or only glow it, and what color does it glow?

partB_heat.note: Not pass/fail — margin maps to how far up the glow ladder he climbs. Bands (by margin): 11-15 cherry-red / 16-22 bright orange / 23-29 yellow + focal softening / 30 yellow-white, slumps at the point. MELT is deliberately past the reachable band (thin fire-well + Journeyman ceiling) — a nat-20 tops out at yellow-white softening, never a clean melt-through.

reading.result: ORANGE-BRIGHT tier (margin 18). He pushes his Ember as hard as he can hold it and drives the steel up the glow ladder to a bright, scorching ORANGE — real, dangerous heat, hot enough to sear flesh / ignite / burn — but it WILL NOT go further. The metal glows, does not soften, does not slump, does not melt. He finds the wall: orange-hot is his current ceiling on solid steel; a true melt is far above him. LEARNED (the payoff is information): full-push Ember = orange-hot on steel, scorching but sub-melt. PROGRESSION: competent intensity use of Ember Channel, but NOT the novel yellow-white feat (margin <23) — NO Expert-promotion demo banked; skill stays Journeyman 4. NO affinity tick (skill-USE of Ember, not absorption -> Ember Manipulation stays 3). COST: Focus 78->62 (-16, sustained max-intensity push), Stamina 46->44 (-2). HP unchanged. The pauldron cools red->grey, heat-kissed but functionally unharmed. He is PREPARING (floor 3 not attempted — no assumed follow-up). NO Tower reset.
